training.normal_training: all frozen RCR normal training windows, no subsampling
training.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full normal-validation objective, never test labels

validation_objectives.tranad: 0.5 first-output MSE + 0.5 second-output MSE, final time step
validation_objectives.anomaly_transformer: reconstruction MSE; association remains in training objective
validation_objectives.dcdetector: symmetric association KL (series term); do not use identically zero detached minmax difference
validation_objectives.omnianomaly: reconstruction MSE + 0.01 KL, deterministic validation latent mean

evaluation.window_to_snippet: top 5 percent mean, ceil, minimum one

declared_differences: Native architectures, training losses and anomaly scores differ from RCR; this is not a matched-capacity structural ablation.
TranAD uses window32 here to match the frozen RCR window cohort; legacy TranAD used window10.
Baseline gradient clipping5 retained; RCR does not clip gradients.
Anomaly Transformer and DCdetector checkpoint objectives are explicitly defined above; a common numerical loss across models is not meaningful.
